body: ac-00: B07 audit + dual-encoder design. codegraph the consumers of models/model2vec + EMBED_DIM/EMBED_AGG_DIM (value-agg branch, 128-dim header branch, semantic/entity/sense classifiers). Design: 2nd Model2VecResources for the value branch, config-selected (value_embed_model), potion-4M stays for header+classifiers; decide EMBED_DIM/AGG 1024 handling (config vs const) without breaking the 128-dim header. Deliverable: consumer graph + edit set + config-schema change.

ac-01: implement dual-encoder native inference. Binary loads potion-4M (header+classifiers) + potion-8M (value-agg 1024); value model config-selected so v19/m2v-244 unchanged. Place potion-8M artifact + config. VERIFY native potion-8M profiles, native gold composed ~= offline 0.794 + Sense ~= 0.522 (HALT+diagnose if not), v19 unaffected. Tests + B07 + clippy -D + cargo test green.

ac-02 (BLOCKING H05): native corpus-honest gate on potion-8M = the real GO/NO-GO vs v19 (replaces invalid offline gate). gittables_corpus_pass native + corpus_honest_gate vs v19_gated oracle (categorical->word remap). Deliverable: verdict + triggers classified collapse vs over-emit.

ac-03: principled value-rule fixes for blocking triggers, re-gate to GO. Leading-zero numeric_code promotion FIRST (xref t-0000a86b18b9de4d9bff03b8, biggest shared collapse, helps all models). Value-based (0048/0096) + kill switch + ledger per rule. Re-gate native until GO + composed holds. HALT if >~4 rules (fix data drift instead).

ac-04: SHIP if GO + composed holds + scoreboard clean. package -> HF upload -> swap models/default -> potion-8M, version bump, CHANGELOG, count surfaces + latency note, CLAUDE.md (v19 retired -> potion-8M default). Else documented fallback (stay v19; next bet = fix fresh-retrain data drift).

Diagnose + fix fresh-retrain data/recipe drift (numeric_code/isbn/npi collapse, si_number/file_size/username over-emit onto oracle-refuted cols) so a freshly trained reproducible model validates by construction. This is the real blocker behind potion-8M's native HALT (composed 0.690 vs v19 0.797 once the validation veto applies). Gold-blind; only the veto/corpus-honest gate sees it. The dual-encoder is built + proven and ready to reuse if a bigger value encoder is still wanted afterwards. Start with the destination-drift precheck on the fresh build + the banked leading-zero numeric_code rule (t-0000a86b, model-agnostic).

PAUSED/SUSPECT 2026-06-23: premise was a FALSE ALARM. potion-8M's native gap was a config bug (missing type_index_keys zeroed the validation branch), fixed in fb44b26 — potion-8M ties v19 on gold natively. The m2v-244 corpus NO-GO that motivated this task is itself suspect (same bug). Re-check m2v-244's corpus-honest gate WITH the fix before any data-drift work; the drift may not exist. t-0000a86b leading-zero numeric_code rule remains independently useful.

RE-ACTIVATED 2026-06-23: premise VALIDATED. potion-8M faithful corpus-honest gate = NO-GO, 14 triggers (numeric_code collapse 7014->0, isbn collapse, user_agent 7.2x, si_number 2.5x over-emit) — same signature as m2v-244 (whose config HAD type_index_keys, so its NO-GO was real too). The drift is in the shared fresh-retrain data blend, NOT the earlier config bug. This IS the real next bet. Priority targets: (1) numeric_code leading-zero rule t-0000a86b (biggest, model-agnostic), (2) user_agent over-emit, (3) isbn/si_number. Fix data recipe so a fresh model is corpus-clean by construction; dual-encoder ready to reuse after.
